scope: Two original static-channel cases, source/log diagnosis of two original legacy UDP probes, one supplementary RDPEUDP2 probe. No broad regression run.

findings.description: Culture-sensitive string IndexOf("\0") yields index 0 on this macOS runtime, producing padded dictionary keys. Valid rdpdr channel 1004 was negotiated, but key RDPDR\0\0 does not match lookup RDPDR.
findings.proof: Original two failures reproduced; diagnostic channel bytes and dictionary keys logged; one-line patch advanced both tests beyond lookup in both modes.
findings.applies_to: All seven S7 static-channel tests contain this lookup; only the two BVT cases were run.

findings.description: GENERAL_CAPS_SET V1 uses a fixed 44-byte length and writes V2-only SpecialTypeDeviceCap. FreeRDP rejects its 36-byte payload; V1 requires 32 bytes plus 8-byte header.
findings.repair: Version-aware length and optional field encode/decode.
findings.proof: Both cases fail in both modes after lookup fix with expected 32, got 36. With both patches, capability response is received and test advances to final device-list wait.

findings.description: Driver omits RDPDR_USER_LOGGEDON_PDU from server capabilities yet sends that packet when client advertises support. FreeRDP logs client supported, server not found and ignores it; final device-list wait times out.
findings.repair: Not attempted; first make server advertised capabilities and transmitted logon sequence agree, then rerun without weakening assertions.
findings.proof: Both BVT cases still fail in standard and bridge modes after both prerequisite patches.
findings.disposition: Keep Not implemented; no overall pass or confirmed client defect.

findings.description: Both original initialization probes negotiate RDPUDP v1. This fork accepts only version 3/RDPEUDP2 and explicitly declines v1/v2.
findings.disposition: Inapplicable to this fork's current v3-only transport; do not reinterpret v3 replacements as the original tests passing.

findings.confidence: partial-runtime-evidence; nullable-ACK failure inferred from source
findings.description: S3_DataTransfer_V2_ClientReceiveData establishes RDPEUDP2, TLS and multitransport tunnel, then logs generated DataSeqNum before cleanup and an 80s outer deadline. Source immediately dereferences optional ACK.Value; packet factory can omit ACK. No TRX or exception stack was produced, so the exact failure/cleanup hang remains unconfirmed.
findings.disposition: Not implemented; investigate optional ACK handling and cleanup, then rerun actual v3 tests.
